Magic links in detail
Recipients: users of the NCP organization with role
provider_business_user
and
in group
offering-validator
. Basic users never receive them.
The backend asks the Keycloak extension endpoint
POST /realms/{realm}/clustruffle/create-action-token
to
mint an action token containing the offering id and a nonce.
When clicked, Keycloak validates the nonce with the backend, logs
the user in and redirects with
from=magic-link
.
Valid 1 hour; resend possible for 7 days after routing.
Magic-link emails use the critical retry policy (10 attempts over
about 25 minutes) because they are the only way an NCP learns about a
request.
Reliability
Ordinary notifications retry 5 times over about 2.5 minutes.
Permanent failures are absorbed (and counted in metric
clustruffle_workflow_activity_abandoned
) so a workflow
replay never re-sends email to users.
